title: Mallard Sample Tracker V2
notes: Restored the original Mallard numbering: 1000 series Non Oilfield, 2000 series Oilfield and 3000 series Odd / Weird.
Added disposal tracking with quick choices for MROR, Secure and One Environmental plus custom facilities, dump date, reference and notes.
Upgraded the mobile interface with exact next-number previews, faster search and filters, priority samples, sample matrix, repeat-sample cloning and clearer record sections.
Added record revisions and conflict protection so one device does not silently overwrite a newer edit from another device.
Expanded audit history to include field edits, lab edits, disposal changes and lab test add, edit and remove events.
Hardened sample identity so assigned sample numbers and their category cannot be changed from the browser.
